_doc: Cameras in plan cm (x east, y south, z up). Level two-point perspective; shift_y = vertical lens shift in frame heights. hfov = horizontal FOV deg. Eye heights are above the room's own floor (garage floor is -60).

cameras.title: Living - toward sofa, feature wall & east glazing
cameras.notes: The bronze feature wall is completely solid: no door, no opening in it. The black column at the far left edge is the kitchen's fridge column. No wall lights or sconces anywhere on the bronze wall.

cameras.title: Living - from SE glass corner toward kitchen & dining (shows double height + gallery edge)
Kitchen - from dining, island and full kitchen run
cameras.notes: The large brown block at the far left edge is the freestanding walnut-slat clad column: solid, no window, no opening.

cameras.title: Kitchen island - 3/4 view from living edge
Dining - from kitchen aisle toward double door & terrace
cameras.notes: The wall between the glazed double door and the right-hand edge of the frame is a solid plain wall: no door, no opening in it.

cameras.title: Spa - from entry: frameless glass sauna (left), jacuzzi, east glazing
cameras.notes: The sauna is a closed, frameless glass box: its glass door is CLOSED and you see the timber benches and warm bench lighting through the glass. The jacuzzi sits free in the room in front of the tall east window.

cameras.title: Spa - from glazing back toward jacuzzi, shower and sauna glass
Guest WC - from door
Garage - elevated arrival view from the top of the steps (true size; shows the floor around the car)
cameras.notes: The car is parked nose-in: its FRONT (grille, three-pointed star, round headlights, windscreen) faces this camera; its rear spare wheel faces the garage door.

cameras.title: Garage - from garage-door corner toward steps (car rear 3/4)
cameras.notes: The car is parked nose-in: we see its REAR (spare wheel on the tailgate) nearest the camera and its front pointing away toward the steps.

cameras.title: Entrance hall - double-height entry, stair, upper landing
cameras.notes: The entrance hall is double height: above it is the open upper landing edged with frameless glass railings, the tall upper window and the stair rising to the landing. Keep it open - no ceiling over that part.

cameras.title: Master suite - facing the faceted walnut bed wall (from the TV wall)
cameras.notes: Nothing hangs in front of the faceted walnut wall: no pendant, no ring, no mirror, no picture on it - only its LED seams. No bench or ottoman at the foot of the bed. The three beige spheres by the glass are dried pampas plumes in a tall dark vase.

cameras.title: Master suite - from the wardrobe side toward the east glass (bed, walnut canopy, marble TV wall, dusk view)
cameras.notes: Nothing hangs in front of the faceted walnut wall: no pendant, no ring, no mirror, no picture on it - only its LED seams. No bench or ottoman at the foot of the bed. The three beige spheres by the glass are dried pampas plumes in a tall dark vase.

cameras.title: Master suite - from the east glass toward black-glass wardrobes and door
cameras.notes: Nothing hangs in front of the faceted walnut wall: no pendant, no ring, no mirror, no picture on it - only its LED seams. No bench or ottoman at the foot of the bed. The three beige spheres by the glass are dried pampas plumes in a tall dark vase.

cameras.title: Bedroom 1 - from the entry toward the bed and the south glazing
Bedroom 2 - facing the bed (headboard on the east wall)
Master en-suite - facing the north wall: smoked-glass shower, WC under the window, ring-mirror vanity
Bathroom 1 - facing the vanity wall
cameras.notes: The white box at the bottom left, under the window, is a wall-hung square white toilet seen from slightly above: show its slim white lid and seat and the black flush plate on the wall above it. The camera stands inside the shower: the clear glass screen runs through the left part of the frame.

_doc_heroes: Hero view per space is generated first and approved; every other view of that space gets it as IMAGE 2 (materials/fittings/light reference; geometry only from IMAGE 1).
_doc_moods: A hero with no approved render yet gets the client's mood reference for its space as IMAGE 2 (materials/finish/light only, never layout).
